description: Use this when a user wants to compare a company's French gender-equality index (Index Egapro) with its sector, its region or France as a whole. Returns the mean, quartiles and median indicators of the latest public declarations, for one sector (NAF code or plain words such as 'banque'), one region, both, or nationally when neither is given. Aggregated public data (data.gouv.fr) only; groups under 5 companies are never published. No private company or employee data.

region.description: Optional. French region name, e.g. 'Île-de-France' or 'Bretagne'.

sector.description: Optional. NAF code (62.02A, 64.19Z; a 2-digit division lists its sub-sectors) or sector words ('banque', 'conseil').

name: benchmark_egapro

companyCount.description: Number of reporting companies in this group.

overall.description: Score out of 100 (mean, quartiles) and median of each indicator.

pageUrl.description: Public PariteCK page with the full benchmark.

scope.description: Which group the figures describe; not_found when nothing can be published.

sectorCandidates.description: When several sectors match the words given: call again with one nafCode.
